title: RECITE: Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence
title_zh: RECITE：结合文本证据修订资格标准

paragraphs.en: 提出RECITE框架，利用ClinicalTrials.gov修订证据自动发现并实施临床试验资格标准的放宽。 Overly restrictive eligibility criteria contribute to widespread enrollment failure in clinical trials, yet published recommendations for how specific criteria should be broadened remain disconnected from trial design at scale. We introduce RECITE (Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence), a framework for automated discovery, extraction, and implementation of evidence-based eligibility criteria revisions. RECITE uses protocol amendment documents from ClinicalTrials.gov to construct a dataset of 11,913 curated instances across 5,735 trials, each pairing original criteria with documentary evidence and target revisions. We benchmark fifteen LLM configurations under truncated-to-context-window and retrieval-augmented generation conditions, on a 3,116-instance sample under an LLM-as-judge protocol validated against ten domain experts (judge vs. human quadratic-weighted Cohen's $κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$). The best open-weight model, Gemma 2 9B, achieves $κ_{qw}$-aligned ordinal score $3.0 \pm 0.9$ on a 0--4 scale (normalized 0.742) and the best closed-weight model, GPT-4o, reaches $3.0 \pm 0.8$ (normalized 0.745). Using an agentic literature discovery system, we then identified 44 paper--trial matches across five publications providing trial-design and EC-modification evidence. Our findings suggest that existing clinical knowledge can be operationalized into actionable trial design recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 提出RECITE框架，利用ClinicalTrials.gov的修订证据自动发现并实施临床试验资格标准的放宽。过于严苛的资格标准是临床试验普遍入组失败的原因之一，然而已发表的关于应如何放宽特定标准的建议仍与大规模的试验设计相脱节。 我们提出RECITE（Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence，结合文本证据修订资格标准），一个用于自动发现、提取并实施基于证据的资格标准修订的框架。 RECITE利用ClinicalTrials.gov的方案修订文档，构建了一个包含来自5,735项试验的11,913条精选实例的数据集，每条实例都将原始标准与文档证据及目标修订配对。 我们在从截断到上下文窗口的条件与检索增强生成条件下，对十五种LLM配置进行了基准测试，在一个3,116条实例的样本上采用经十位领域专家验证的LLM-as-judge协议（评判模型与人类的二次加权Cohen's $κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$）。 表现最佳的开源权重模型Gemma 2 9B在0–4量表上取得了与$κ_{qw}$一致的序数得分$3.0 \pm 0.9$（归一化后为0.742），表现最佳的闭源权重模型GPT-4o达到$3.0 \pm 0.8$（归一化后为0.745）。 随后，我们利用一个智能体文献发现系统，从五篇出版物中识别出44个论文–试验匹配对，为试验设计和EC修订提供了证据。 我们的研究结果表明，现有临床知识可以被转化为可操作的试验设计建议。
